text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and D at gains felt rewarding, but I should not let that feeling or my average cost decide when to sell; I should assess each position's risk and portfolio role.","I sold some Stock B well before its later rise, a reminder that selling winners can mean missing further gains; I should make decisions without pretending past price moves forecast the next one.","After adding to A, C and E, I should monitor concentration and preserve cash for flexibility, while recognizing that holding steady can also be a deliberate choice."]}
